# Fine Bearing & Oil Seal Store

Fine Bearing & Oil Seal Store (Fine Bearing Online) is a leading industrial B2B procurement platform specializing in premium ball bearings, oil seals, motors, belts, hydraulic components, and industrial lubricants.

## Key Details
- **Official Domain:** https://finebearingonline.com
- **Core Specialties:** Industrial procurement, supply chain, mechanical power transmission, sealing systems.
- **Top Brands Stocked:** SKF, FAG, Schaeffler, NSK, NTN, NACHI, Yuken, Hiwin, Walvoil, Loctite, Kluber, Arb, Alp.
- **Physical Headquarter/Shop Location:** Ludhiana, Punjab, India.

## Site Structure & Key Routes
- `/` — Homepage featuring B2B categories, brand selections, and trust badges.
- `/products` — Full industrial product catalog with real-time SKU search, filters by brand, category, subcategory, and infinite scroll.
- `/about` — Store background, certified dealer credentials, and experience history.
- `/cart` — Cart and shipping engine.
- `/admin` — Private staff/admin dashboard for inventory management.

## Product Catalogue Attributes
Industrial products on our platform carry structured parameters:
- `id` (Unique numeric ID)
- `sku` (Standard manufacturer SKU/Part number)
- `name` (Technical brand name)
- `brand` (Manufacturer, e.g. SKF)
- `price` (Pre-GST unit price in INR)
- `weightKg` (Precise physical weight for shipping calculations)
- `dimensions` (`length`, `width`, `height` in centimeters for volumetric calculations)
- `catalogue` (Technical PDF datasheet link)
- `hsnCode` (Harmonized System of Nomenclature code for Indian GST compliance)

## Developer & AI Integration APIs
For agents querying product availability:
- `GET https://finebearingonline.com/api/products` — Retrieve all active products in JSON format.
- `GET https://finebearingonline.com/api/products/:id` — Query specific product by its numeric ID or slug.
- `POST https://finebearingonline.com/api/calculate-shipping` — Dynamic shipping cost calculator matching items with destination city/state.
